question: During Pakistan's 2018 general-election campaign, Siraj Raisani was a candidate of which political party?
questionUrdu: پاکستان کے 2018 general-election campaign میں Siraj Raisani کس سیاسی جماعت کے امیدوار تھے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”Balochistan Awami Party“ ہے۔ Siraj Raisani نے Balochistan Awami Party میں شمولیت اختیار کی تھی۔ وہ 2018 کے election campaign کے دوران Mastung میں ایک حملے میں جاں بحق ہوئے۔

references.label: COISS situational update: Pakistan
references.claimSummary: The Australian government report identifies Siraj Raisani as a Balochistan Awami Party leader and candidate at the July 2018 Mastung rally.

references.label: BMM merges with Balochistan Awami Party
references.claimSummary: Dawn independently records that Siraj Raisani joined the Balochistan Awami Party before the 2018 election.

sourceNotes: The 2018 election context was added because party affiliation can change over time.

question: In which Balochistan district was the July 2018 election rally attacked where Siraj Raisani was killed?
questionUrdu: July 2018 میں وہ election rally بلوچستان کے کس ضلع میں نشانہ بنی جہاں Siraj Raisani جاں بحق ہوئے؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”Mastung“ ہے۔ یہ حملہ Mastung district میں ایک election gathering پر ہوا۔ Siraj Raisani سمیت بڑی تعداد میں لوگ اس دہشت گرد حملے میں جاں بحق ہوئے۔

references.label: COISS situational update: Pakistan
references.claimSummary: Australian Department of Home Affairs supports that Siraj Raisani was killed in the July 2018 attack on an election rally in Mastung district.

references.label: BMM merges with Balochistan Awami Party
references.claimSummary: Dawn supports that Siraj Raisani was killed in the July 2018 attack on an election rally in Mastung district.

question: Why is the stratospheric ozone layer important to life on Earth?
questionUrdu: Stratospheric ozone layer زمین پر زندگی کے لیے کیوں اہم ہے؟
options: Protection from ultraviolet rays of sun
It releases oxygen in the air
It maintains temperature of the earth
It releases hydrogen in the atmosphere
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”Protection from ultraviolet rays of sun“ ہے۔ Ozone layer سورج کی نقصان دہ ultraviolet radiation کا بڑا حصہ جذب کرتی ہے۔ اس طرح یہ جلد، آنکھوں اور دوسرے جاندار نظاموں کو زیادہ UV exposure سے بچاتی ہے۔

references.label: Ultraviolet radiation
references.claimSummary: WHO explains that the ozone layer absorbs harmful ultraviolet radiation from the Sun.

references.label: Basic ozone-layer science
references.claimSummary: EPA independently states that stratospheric ozone protects life by absorbing harmful solar ultraviolet radiation.

sourceNotes: The stem was narrowed to the stratospheric ozone layer and to its principal protective role.

question: How many oxygen atoms make up one ozone molecule?
questionUrdu: Ozone کے ایک molecule میں oxygen کے کتنے atoms ہوتے ہیں؟
explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”Three“ ہے۔ Ozone کا chemical formula O3 ہے، اس لیے اس میں oxygen کے تین atoms ہوتے ہیں۔ عام oxygen gas کا formula O2 ہوتا ہے۔

references.label: Basic ozone-layer science
references.claimSummary: United States Environmental Protection Agency supports that one ozone molecule contains three oxygen atoms.

references.label: Ozone facts
references.claimSummary: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center supports that one ozone molecule contains three oxygen atoms.

sourceNotes: Original PPSC-style practice question derived from the cited authorities; it is not copied from the source book.

question: From which listed Arabic root noun is the term 'aqidah' derived?

explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”A bond or knot“ ہے۔ Aqd کا بنیادی مفہوم گرہ، بندھن یا مضبوط معاہدہ ہے۔ اسی سے Aqidah میں دل سے مضبوطی سے باندھی ہوئی belief کا تصور پیدا ہوتا ہے۔

question: Domestic liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) commonly contains which two listed hydrocarbons?

explanationUrdu: درست جواب ”Butane & Propane“ ہے۔ LPG عموماً propane، butane یا دونوں کے mixture پر مشتمل ہوتی ہے۔ ترکیب ملک، موسم اور supplier کے لحاظ سے مختلف ہوسکتی ہے۔
